note: Target the-broken-column article's coreSummary and opening section document 1944 bed rest and a steel corset, no spinal operation in 1944, and a later spinal fusion in 1946. This supports the bridge's contrast between the popular 'after surgery' caption and the documented timeline.
sentence: A similar gap between a popular caption and the documented record shows up in [Frida Kahlo's The Broken Column](/the-broken-column/), usually described as a recovery painting made after her spinal surgery even though the medical record she left behind places it before.
